stem: An 8-year-old with four documented tetanus-containing vaccines, most recently at age 4 years, presents with a dirty wound. What tetanus prophylaxis is required?

options.text: No tetanus-specific prophylaxis beyond wound care
Restart the full tetanus vaccine course
Three doses of tetanus vaccine over one week

explanation: With a complete primary tetanus vaccination history and a recent booster within the recommended interval, no additional tetanus-specific prophylaxis is required for a dirty wound beyond appropriate wound care.
